scope: Read-only CPU diagnostic; no retraining; existing 8 train batches only
raw_adjustment_definition: eta * alpha * S = 0.125 * S; zero outside supported selected parent anchor

normalization.current: Each actual optimizer minibatch contains one trajectory from each of four windows, with request weight 1/(4*20)=1/80. Replica orders are independently shuffled by window; replica0 local anchors can be distributed across optimizer minibatches.
normalization.clarification: The proposed auxiliary denominator is the fixed 8 planned anchors for the entire collection, not the planned anchors in the current optimizer minibatch. Replacing 1/80 with 1/8 raises each contributing local request scalar coefficient by 10x, wherever that request is assigned. This is not an actual gradient-norm estimate.
normalization.interpretation: Local correction is sparse and small in the all-request objective; multiplying every term by 1/80 itself does not change the local/RLOO norm ratio. Mixed whitening std is almost unchanged. A separate loss normalized by all 8 planned collection anchors deliberately raises each local request coefficient by 10x; this is a strategy hypothesis, not a fix for proven numerical erasure.

caveats: EST2 SE uses only two independent seeded continuations per slot and assumes slot independence; descriptive only, not confidence intervals or a test.
Identical realized two-draw returns yield zero rough SE without establishing zero true noise.
Common whitening centering spreads a small mean adjustment to nonanchor rows; listed sparse correction is pre-centering.
Loss coefficient / raw advantage norm does not equal policy gradient norm, clipped update size, or Adam step.
Normalization dilution is consistent with sparse small scalar exposure; it is not a demonstrated root cause of performance loss or an implementation bug.
recommendation: Worth one fixed exact_aux arm with 16 optimizer updates, reusing the existing RLOO16 comparator: baseline RLOO centered/whitened alone; local exact S divided by the same baseline sample std and applied in a separate PPO term with fixed alpha=.5 eta=.25, normalized by 8 planned anchors, NA remains zero. Keep all parent RLOO requests unchanged; compare both existing evaluation namespaces, with no sweep or retuning. EST2 noise is substantial, so absence of improvement should end this scale pilot rather than trigger weight search.
grouping_note: by_replica_index is a descriptive grouping by parent replicate_index, not actual optimizer minibatch assignment. Trainer independently shuffles replica order per episode, so selected replica0 requests need not occur in the same optimizer update.
